BALOCIIISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT (ELECTION) RULES, 1983
BALOCIIISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(ELECTION) RULES, 1983
(Substitution of
Nomination Forms IV, XX and XXI)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 13th January, 1999]
No. SO.II(LG/E)1‑2/98,
dated 13‑1‑1999.‑‑ In the exercise of the power
conferred by section 150 read with section 23 of the Balochistan Local
Government Ordinance, 1980 (II of 1980), the Government of Balochistan is
pleased to amend the Balochistan Local Government (Election) Rules, 1983,
namely:‑‑
For the Nomination Forms IV, XX
and XXI, for Muslim, Non‑Muslim and Special Interest Groups Seats the
following shall be substituted:
URDU Images
